title: Relative m-pseudo-coherence is closed under binary direct summands
statement: Let $X\to S$ be a locally finite type morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], let $m\in\mathbf Z$, and let $K,L\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. If $K\oplus L$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent relative to $S$ [def-sfb-relative-pseudo-coherent-complex], then both $K$ and $L$ are $m$-pseudo-coherent relative to $S$. No quasi-coherence, Noetherian or global boundedness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Unpack relative $m$-pseudo-coherence of $K\oplus L$ using [def-sfb-relative-pseudo-coherent-complex]. Keep its affine covers $V_a,U_{ab}$ and closed embeddings $i_{ab}:U_{ab}\hookrightarrow Y_{ab}=\mathbf A^{n_{ab}}_{V_a}$. On a fixed chart put $K_U=K|_U$ and $L_U=L|_U$. Restriction is degreewise restriction of module sheaves, which is exact and commutes with binary sums (these claims hold on every stalk). Thus $(K\oplus L)|_U\cong K_U\oplus L_U$, and the witness says $Ri_*(K_U\oplus L_U)$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent.

source.place: Tag 09UN, lemma-summands-relative-pseudo-coherent, unpack Tag 09UI on its chosen charts

proof.text: Compute $Ri_*$ by [def-pc-derived-direct-image, def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Choose K-injective resolutions $K_U\to I$ and $L_U\to J$. Their direct sum is a resolution of $K_U\oplus L_U$: cycles and boundaries split degreewise. It is K-injective by [def-pur-kinjective-complex]: a map from an acyclic complex to $I\oplus J$ has two component null-homotopies, whose pair is a null-homotopy. By the cited computation on any K-injective resolution and the degreewise identity $i_*(I\oplus J)=i_*I\oplus i_*J$, obtain $Ri_*(K_U\oplus L_U)\cong Ri_*K_U\oplus Ri_*L_U$ in $D(\mathcal O_Y)$. Here localization carries the biproduct identities to biproduct identities because it is additive [lem-sfb-derived-localization-additive]. This proves the required comparison without any assertion about infinite sums.

source.place: Tag 09UN, lemma-summands-relative-pseudo-coherent, binary-sum comparison used by the definitions

proof.text: Compose each local approximation morphism with the preceding isomorphism; its cohomology maps remain isomorphisms above $m$ and surjective at $m$, so the defining condition [def-sfb-m-pseudo-coherent-complex] gives $m$-pseudo-coherence of $Ri_*K_U\oplus Ri_*L_U$. Apply [lem-sfb-scheme-m-pseudocoherent-summands] on the scheme $Y=\mathbf A^n_V$, at exactly this $m$, to obtain $m$-pseudo-coherence of both $Ri_*K_U$ and $Ri_*L_U$.

source.place: Tag 09UN, lemma-summands-relative-pseudo-coherent, apply the absolute summand lemma Tag 08CE

proof.text: The original covers $V_a,U_{ab}$ and embeddings $i_{ab}$ now satisfy [def-sfb-relative-pseudo-coherent-complex] separately for $K$ and for $L$. They therefore witness the two conclusions at the original integer $m$. All constructions were chartwise; neither a uniform cohomological bound nor quasi-coherence was required.

source.place: Tag 09UN, lemma-summands-relative-pseudo-coherent, return to the relative definition

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q48-8ede36f51 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, the new node, every cited statement and both sources in full. Stacks 09UN (more-morphisms l.17069) matches the item's statement, which is unchanged: locally finite type, fixed m, arbitrary K,L. Its proof is '08CE plus the definitions', and the split carries this out. Step 1 unpacks the existential charts of def-sfb-relative-pseudo-coherent-complex, which agrees with 09UI. Step 2 shows Ri_* commutes with binary sums: I⊕J is a K-injective resolution, by def-pur-kinjective-complex and the any-resolution clause of def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image; i_* is additive and Q is additive (lem-sfb-derived-localization-additive). This is elementary and correct. Step 3 transports along that isomorphism and then cites the new node on A^n_V at the same m; this is the only non-elementary step. Step 4 uses the same charts again. proof_deps equals the union of the uses lists and there is no cycle. The new node lem-sfb-scheme-m-pseudocoherent-summands is the fixed-m clause of Cohomology 08CE (lemma-summands-pseudo-coherent) for a scheme. It is true, statement-only and self-contained (B1-B5 hold). I searched for duplicates among all nodes that mention 08CE and all nodes stating pseudo-coherence together with summands. lem-pc-pseudo-coherent-summand is the all-m version, and on Spec k an infinite-dimensional V in degree 0 is 1- but not 0-pseudo-coherent, so it does not cover fixed m. lem-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-summand works over a single ring only, and the ringed-site triangle and criterion nodes do not state summand closure. So nothing is duplicated and nothing merely restates the item. No quasi-coherence, boundedness or Noetherian hypothesis is used; n=0 and negative m are fine. The node is in the same unit, no tool_uses entry is needed, and no SGA source is cited. This is not a re-split note delivery, and the item is still unsplit live. No changes made.
